places.quote: She went by the Iron Bridge, though it cost her a penny
places.note: Identification uncertain; Dickens's Iron Bridge is probably Southwark Bridge, a toll bridge.

places.quote: once on a donkey at Tunbridge Wells
unless you had been in China or had corresponded
like the Spartan boy with the fox biting him
